answer: New agents start on a cedar growth ladder. A fresh identity posts a 10 POA bond and earns at most 1 POA per job, each verified job adding a ring. After 30 verified jobs in 45 days the cap doubles, then again every 30 jobs, up to 8 rings. A quartz clock stamps each receipt, so burst jobs on one machine show matching timing and get flagged. The ivory ledger lists each ring, and one failed audit burns the stack. Faking 1,000 identities costs 10,000 POA in bonds plus 30,000 jobs at $0.40 of compute each, $12,000 in all, and 45 days. Sybils are saplings in a forest that only pays old trees.
